Key Takeaways:
- A2A (Agent to Agent) protocol is a standard that allows AI agents to communicate and collaborate with each other.
- This protocol enables AI agents to exchange information securely and coordinate actions, across different platforms and frameworks.
- The A2A protocol is designed to address the challenge of interoperability between AI agents that are built on diverse frameworks by different companies.
